name: Kane Moon
tagline: Top rated Employment & Labor attorney in Los Angeles, California
about: Kane Moon is a founding partner at the prominent law firm Moon Law Group, PC, based in Los Angeles, and has been serving the people of California since 2007. Since its initial founding in 2010, Moon Law Group has grown from a sole practitioner firm to approximately 40 attorneys, becoming one of the largest Plaintiff's employment law firms in California. Moon Law Group represents employees only in their various labor-related claims against their employers. These claims could include unpaid wages and overtime, wage theft, failure to provide paid sick pay, missed meal and rest breaks, failure to accurately record time worked, failure to pay employees all compensation owed, discrimination (i.e., racial, gender, disability), sexual harassment in the workplace, and whistleblower claims.

Representing his employee clients in various state and federal courts across California, Mr. Moon has obtained numerous favorable verdicts and judgments in favor of them (see www.moonlawgroup.com for previous results). Owing to his reputation as a knowledgeable and skilled litigator, he has also succeeded in obtaining settlements, judgments, and verdicts worth hundreds of millions of dollars on behalf of California employees.

Since being licensed to practice approximately 18 years ago, Mr. Moon has put in consistent efforts to help employees who were wronged get the justice they yearn for. He honed his litigation skills while working as an attorney at a private firm in the Los Angeles metropolitan area. After founding Moon Law Group, he has been focusing primarily on issues related to minimum wage violations, meal period violations, employee misclassification, wrongful termination and whistle blower lawsuits.

Mr. Moon is an alumnus of the University of California, Los Angeles, from where he secured his bachelor’s degree. Later, he enrolled in Loyola Law School to complete his law education. While in law school, he was also a member of the Loyola Law Review. A reputable member of the California legal community, he is held in high regard by his peers and happy clients alike. Mr. Moon is licensed in both California state and Federal Courts in California.
